title: This risotto inspired a gin: A Glorious Pairing at Pecoraro Latteria
caption_instagram:
This risotto inspired a gin. Now they're served side by side. 🍋🌿

Pecoraro Latteria in Williamsburg invited us in for A Glorious Pairing: a lemon rosemary risotto made with @breuckelendistilling Glorious Gin, next to a Glorious Gin Martini washed in the risotto rice.

The story: founder Brad Estabrooke built the Glorious Gin recipe after cooking lemon rosemary risotto at home. Chef Claudio Sottile brought it full circle, with the gin in the pot and the rice in the mixing glass. Lemon and rosemary on the plate, grapefruit and New York grain in the glass. You can actually taste the risotto in the gin.

Pecoraro comes from a family with more than 60 years of Brooklyn mozzarella-making behind it. (In our video we said the place has been there 60 years. It's the family's craft that goes back that far.)

A Glorious Pairing, $46, for a limited time.
📍 636 Metropolitan Ave, Williamsburg

Would you try a martini washed in risotto? Yes or no below. Send this to your dinner plus-one. 🥂

Invited guests of Breuckelen Distilling and Pecoraro Latteria. Transportation was provided. 21+, please drink responsibly.
